easing.note: One easing for transitions: Mel ease. Loops use ease-in-out; spinners and shimmer run linear. No bounce, no overshoot (Brand · 09).

tokens.name: ease-mel
tokens.usage: Every one-time transition: hover, press, reveal, expand, cross-fade. Quick start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-loop
tokens.usage: Looping idle motion: Mel mark breathing, mascot, pulse, voice bars.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Spinners and the Thinking shimmer only.

tokens.usage: Trace and disclosure chevron rotation (Mel web .c-trace__chev).
